title: Vision
description: Heading and two paragraphs next to a three-photo mosaic

title.default: A generation that knows Christ and makes Him known

lead.default: GYC Europe is a youth-led movement that inspires young people to a deeper relationship with Jesus, a love for His Word and a life of mission. We believe young people are not only the church of tomorrow, but part of God's work today.

text.default: We are a supportive ministry of Seventh-day Adventist Church, part of Trans-European Division and members of ASI Europe.
